KC21FindNone.dc.html.note: Matches its board (0 px strict) and its controls work: the tiles show on every Nothing-called state, a tile searches its aisle (Adhesives → Tile glue, Tile grout, Wood glue), Add this walk-in asks once per sale and KC25 comes back when searched again. FAIL on the spec: Truth: the tile order breaks 'one rule, one place'. Spec 04 already has the rule for exactly this state (§4 'Aisles near a search that found nothing', lead ruling 30 Oct, TD14): the closest item's aisle, then the aisles most often bought together with it in the shop's orders, then the shop's aisles — built as today/FindItems.tsx nearAisles. The counter's OpenAisle is a second, different copy (closest aisle, then the shop's aisles), and the new §4.3 row restates that different order. From the demo books at 17 Oct 10:41 the existing rule gives Adhesives · Roofing · Fasteners for 'tile cutter' (KC21, KC25) and Plumbing · Fasteners · Tools for 'PPR pipe 25mm' (KC26, KC28); the boards draw Adhesives · Roofing · Cement and Plumbing · Roofing · Cement. Fix: move nearAisles (and shopAisles, which the counter imports from today/data.ts, another tab's internals) into src/core; call it from Today and the Counter; in §4.3 keep only 'every Nothing-called state shows three aisle tiles below the ask card, page content that may run under the dock' and point to the existing row for the order; redraw the tiles on KC21, KC25, KC26 and KC28 to the rule's result. If Kevin or the lead prefers the counter's simpler order, change the TD14 row and Today instead: one rule either way, never two.
